title: Authentic Irish Lamb Stew
description: This earthy and indulgent Irish dish features tender lamb, silky potatoes, and a hint of ancho chillies, all blended together in a rich and comforting stew.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onions to the pot and cook until they are softened and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the ancho chillies, potatoes, carrots, lamb broth, tomato paste, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Stir to combine, then return the lamb to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the lamb is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot.
Emulsify the stew by stirring in a little bit of the broth into the fat that rises to the top.
